artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: partial_progress schema checks added to validate-return-meta.sh, a new RETURN_META_SCHEMA_VIOLATION Signal A instance, and a warn-only postflight probe giving the previously-orphaned validator its first executing lifecycle call site.

completion_data.completion_summary: Added partial_progress type/conditional-presence checks to validate-return-meta.sh and wired a warn-only probe into orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh, giving the previously-orphaned validator its first executing lifecycle call site; a bare-string partial_progress now warns and records RETURN_META_SCHEMA_VIOLATION instead of silently corrupting a downstream consumer's jq read.

memory_candidates.content: When wiring a warn-only lifecycle probe around a pre-existing STRICT validator (one whose own exit-code contract must stay unchanged), gate the probe on the validator's SPECIFIC output lines for the one check that motivated the wiring (e.g. grep -E '[FAIL].*<field>'), never on the validator's aggregate exit code. An aggregate-exit trigger silently re-activates every OTHER check the validator implements, including checks that were deliberately deferred elsewhere for known false-positive reasons against agents with intentional non-canonical vocabularies. Prove the filter is load-bearing with two falsifiability experiments before committing: (1) temporarily remove the new detection block and confirm only the new positive-case assertions go red; (2) temporarily switch the gate to the aggregate exit code and confirm the noise-guard negative case goes red. Revert both experiments immediately; never commit them.
